In detail

Villaverde Alto has extensive, multi-year press coverage of a proliferation of narcopisos: a 2022 investigation described 'a heroin plague' with roughly 20 new narcopisos increasing insecurity, hundreds of residents demonstrating against the trend, and a resident association mourning a murdered young man from the neighbourhood. Coverage continued into 2025-2026 with reports of a robbery wave using the 'butron' break-in technique, thefts from parked vehicles, and 31 people arrested for armed robberies in a related March 2026 operation. Sources checked: El Mundo, 18 Oct 2022; ABC, 2 Oct 2022; La Razon, 2 Nov 2022; Publico, 7 Oct 2022; Telemadrid, Oct 2025 (robbery wave); Telemadrid, Mar 2026 (31 arrests).
